% VAFT diagram template (TikZ renderer).
% Authored source: the colours and styles every vaft.diagram scene refers to.
% The renderer replaces the body-slot line inside tikzpicture with generated drawing
% commands; nothing else in this file is generated.
\def\pgfsysdriver{pgfsys-dvisvgm.def}
\documentclass[tikz,border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta}
\definecolor{islandblue}{RGB}{28,103,210}
\definecolor{islanddark}{RGB}{22,55,116}
\definecolor{qblue}{RGB}{96,164,232}
\definecolor{meshgray}{RGB}{150,150,150}
\definecolor{chartblue}{RGB}{16,24,140}
\definecolor{driftred}{RGB}{214,48,39}
\definecolor{abskinetic}{RGB}{232,140,24}
\definecolor{absfluid}{RGB}{44,150,84}
\definecolor{absequil}{RGB}{120,72,164}
\tikzset{
  >=Latex,
  every picture/.style={line cap=round,line join=round,font=\large},
  lcfs/.style={line width=0.95pt},
  surface/.style={gray!55,line width=0.42pt},
  rational/.style={islandblue!80!black,dashed,line width=0.65pt},
  passing/.style={islandblue!45,line width=0.5pt},
  island/.style={islandblue,line width=0.52pt},
  separatrix/.style={islandblue,line width=0.95pt},
  opoint/.style={fill=islandblue},
  xpoint/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=0.8pt},
  width arrow/.style={<->,line width=0.65pt},
  leader/.style={->,line width=0.55pt},
  axis/.style={->,line width=0.65pt},
  label/.style={},
  title/.style={font=\huge},
  subtitle/.style={font=\normalsize,text=black!75},
  note/.style={font=\normalsize,text=gray!75!black,align=center},
  o locus/.style={islandblue,line width=1.15pt},
  x locus/.style={islanddark,densely dashed,line width=0.95pt},
  o locus hidden/.style={islandblue,line width=0.7pt,opacity=0.3},
  x locus hidden/.style={islanddark,densely dashed,line width=0.6pt,opacity=0.3},
  mesh/.style={meshgray,line width=0.35pt},
  mesh hidden/.style={meshgray,line width=0.3pt,opacity=0.3},
  machine/.style={line width=0.95pt},
  machine fill/.style={fill=gray!6,draw=none},
  hole/.style={fill=white,draw=none},
  cut/.style={black!70,dash dot,line width=0.7pt},
  inset frame/.style={draw=black!25,rounded corners=2pt},
  chart axis/.style={->,line width=1.4pt},
  boundary/.style={chartblue,line width=1.9pt},
  approx/.style={gray!70!black,dashed,line width=0.9pt},
  region/.style={font=\LARGE,align=center},
  xlabel/.style={font=\LARGE},
  ylabel/.style={font=\LARGE,rotate=90},
  tick/.style={line width=0.7pt},
  ticklabel/.style={font=\normalsize},
  star/.style={fill=black,draw=none},
  orbit ion/.style={islandblue,line width=0.9pt},
  orbit electron/.style={islanddark,line width=0.9pt},
  orbit tip/.style={->,islandblue,line width=0.9pt},
  drift/.style={->,driftred,line width=1.6pt},
  drift ion/.style={->,islandblue,line width=1.6pt},
  drift electron/.style={->,driftred,line width=1.6pt},
  exb/.style={->,black!80,line width=1.8pt},
  vector/.style={->,black,line width=1.1pt},
  field vector/.style={->,islanddark,line width=1.6pt},
  field arrow/.style={->,black!70,line width=1.2pt},
  field line/.style={islanddark,line width=1.6pt},
  field line hidden/.style={islanddark,densely dashed,line width=0.9pt,opacity=0.4},
  leader line/.style={black!45,line width=0.5pt},
  field line arrow/.style={->,islanddark,line width=1.6pt},
  guiding centre/.style={driftred,dashed,line width=1.0pt},
  frame axis/.style={black!60,line width=0.8pt},
  frame axis arrow/.style={->,black!60,line width=0.8pt},
  region box/.style={black,line width=1.0pt},
  current/.style={->,driftred,line width=1.8pt},
  torus rim/.style={black,line width=1.2pt},
  section fill/.style={draw=black,line width=1.4pt,fill=qblue!18},
  charge/.style={draw,circle,inner sep=0.8pt,font=\normalsize},
  charge small/.style={font=\large},
  legend symbol/.style={font=\LARGE},
  small label/.style={font=\normalsize},
  formula box/.style={draw=black!25,rounded corners=2pt,fill=white,align=center,inner sep=5pt,font=\normalsize},
  concept box/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.0pt,rounded corners=3pt,fill=qblue!10},
  concept text/.style={font=\normalsize,align=center},
  concept band/.style={fill=black!4,draw=none},
  concept band label/.style={font=\small\itshape,text=black!60},
  connector/.style={->,black!70,line width=1.0pt},
  connector line/.style={black!70,line width=1.0pt},
  concept leaf/.style={draw=islanddark!60,line width=0.8pt,rounded corners=3pt,fill=white},
  outer solution/.style={chartblue,line width=1.9pt},
  inner solution/.style={driftred,line width=1.9pt},
  slope minus/.style={islandblue,dashed,line width=1.1pt},
  slope plus/.style={driftred,dashed,line width=1.1pt},
  layer/.style={fill=driftred!10,draw=driftred!45,line width=0.6pt},
  match/.style={->,black!70,line width=1.1pt},
  phasor/.style={->,islandblue,line width=1.8pt},
  phasor alt/.style={->,driftred,line width=1.8pt},
  phasor total/.style={->,black,line width=2.2pt},
  component real/.style={driftred,line width=3.2pt},
  component imag/.style={islandblue,line width=3.2pt},
  angle arc/.style={->,black!70,line width=0.9pt},
  crest/.style={islandblue,line width=1.6pt},
  trough/.style={driftred,line width=1.6pt},
  im axis/.style={<->,black!80,line width=1.3pt},
  im axis title/.style={font=\normalsize\bfseries,text=black!80},
  im tick/.style={black!80,line width=1.0pt},
  im grid/.style={black!12,line width=0.6pt},
  im station/.style={font=\small,align=center,text=black!85,execute at begin node={\hyphenpenalty=10000}},
  im example/.style={font=\footnotesize\itshape,align=center,text=black!60,execute at begin node={\hyphenpenalty=10000}},
  im bridge/.style={fill=qblue!16,draw=qblue!70,line width=0.8pt,rounded corners=9pt},
  im conceptual/.style={draw=black!55,dashed,line width=0.8pt,rounded corners=5pt,fill=black!3},
  im capsule/.style={draw=black!60,line width=0.6pt,rounded corners=5pt,inner sep=2.6pt,font=\small,align=center},
  im particle/.style={im capsule,fill=driftred!28,line width=1.2pt},
  im kinetic/.style={im capsule,fill=abskinetic!40,dash dot},
  im fluid/.style={im capsule,fill=absfluid!30,densely dashed},
  im mhd/.style={im capsule,fill=islandblue!24,double,line width=0.4pt},
  im equilibrium/.style={im capsule,fill=absequil!28},
  im global/.style={im capsule,fill=white,dotted,line width=0.9pt},
  im level particle/.style={concept box,fill=driftred!14,draw=driftred!70},
  im level kinetic/.style={concept box,fill=abskinetic!18,draw=abskinetic!80},
  im level fluid/.style={concept box,fill=absfluid!15,draw=absfluid!80},
  im level mhd/.style={concept box,fill=islandblue!12,draw=islandblue!80},
  im level equilibrium/.style={concept box,fill=absequil!14,draw=absequil!80},
  im reduction/.style={->,black!65,line width=1.0pt},
  coupling data flow/.style={->,black!75,line width=1.1pt},
  coupling closure/.style={->,islandblue,dotted,line width=1.5pt},
  coupling calibration/.style={->,driftred,dashed,line width=1.2pt},
  coupling surrogate/.style={->,absequil,dash dot,line width=1.2pt},
  coupling residual/.style={->,abskinetic,loosely dashed,line width=1.3pt},
  coupling validation/.style={->,absfluid,line width=1.3pt},
  coupling feedback/.style={->,black,line width=1.9pt},
  coupling iterative/.style={<->,islanddark,double,line width=0.6pt},
  concept state/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.0pt,rounded corners=8pt,fill=white},
  concept database/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.0pt,fill=absequil!12},
  concept database rim/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.0pt},
  concept group/.style={draw=islanddark!70,dashed,line width=1.0pt,rounded corners=3pt,fill=white},
  concept roof/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.0pt,fill=qblue!22,line join=round,rounded corners=4pt},
  concept source/.style={draw=absfluid!85,line width=0.9pt,rounded corners=3pt,fill=absfluid!12},
  concept group title/.style={font=\normalsize\bfseries,text=islanddark},
  concept pillar/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.0pt,rounded corners=2pt,fill=qblue!8},
  concept base/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.0pt,rounded corners=2pt,fill=absequil!14},
  concept actor/.style={draw=abskinetic!85,line width=1.0pt,rounded corners=6pt,fill=abskinetic!15},
  concept hub/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.3pt,rounded corners=10pt,fill=black!7},
  concept plain/.style={font=\normalsize,align=center,execute at begin node={\hyphenpenalty=10000}},
  concept annotation/.style={font=\small\itshape,text=black!60,align=center,execute at begin node={\hyphenpenalty=10000}},
  concept strong/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.8pt,rounded corners=4pt,fill=qblue!16},
  concept vv/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=1.5pt,rounded corners=4pt,fill=qblue!14},
  concept requirement/.style={draw=absfluid!85,line width=1.3pt,rounded corners=2pt,fill=absfluid!12},
  concept tick/.style={black!45,densely dotted,line width=0.8pt},
  concept reference/.style={font=\footnotesize,text=black!65,align=center,execute at begin node={\hyphenpenalty=10000}},
  connector strong/.style={->,islanddark,line width=1.7pt},
  connector both/.style={<->,black!70,line width=1.0pt},
  connector feedback/.style={->,black!55,dashed,line width=1.0pt},
  connector dependency/.style={->,black!40,line width=0.7pt},
}
